arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import zipfile, re
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
s = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode()
rows = re.findall(r'<row r=\"(\d+)\"[^>]*>(.*?)</row>', s, re.S)
cats = {}
total = 0.0
for r, body in rows:
    r = int(r)
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        a = re.search(r'<c r=\"A%d\"[^>]*>(.*?)</c>' % r, body, re.S).group(1)
        b = re.search(r'<c r=\"B%d\"[^>]*>(.*?)</c>' % r, body, re.S).group(1)
        c = re.search(r'<c r=\"C%d\"[^>]*>(.*?)</c>' % r, body, re.S).group(1)
        cat = re.search(r'<t>([^<]*)</t>', a).group(1)
        item = re.search(r'<t>([^<]*)</t>', b).group(1)
        val = float(re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>', c).group(1))
        cats.setdefault(cat, []).append((item, val))
        total += val
for cat, items in cats.items():
    print(cat + ': ' + ' + '.join('%s (%g)' % (n, v) for n, v in items) + ' = %g' % sum(v for _, v in items))
print('TOTAL EXPENSES (rows 11-22, col C) = %g' % total)
"
